subject: general
question: What sum will earn a simple interest of ₹1,056 in 3 years at 16% per year rate of interest?
solution:
**Given:**

Simple Interest (SI) = ₹1,056

Time (t) = 3 years

Rate of Interest (r) = 16% per year

**Formula used:**

SI = dfrac{P times r times t}{100} 

Where, P = Principal

**Calculation:**

1,056 = dfrac{P times 16 times 3}{100} 

⇒ 1,056 = dfrac{48P}{100} 

⇒ 1,056 = 0.48P

⇒ P = dfrac{1,056}{0.48} 

⇒ P = 2,200

**∴ The correct answer is option (1).**
